obsidian-loam.$description: Obsidian Loam — Page canvas, hero background, card surfaces — the near-black base with a faint olive cast that keeps the dark from feeling synthetic

bone-vellum.$description: Bone Vellum — Primary text, body copy, headings, icon strokes, border color on dark — warm off-white that reads as paper, not LCD white

iron-filings.$description: Iron Filings — Hairline borders, footer dividers, low-emphasis rules

drift-ash.$description: Drift Ash — Muted secondary text, placeholder input state, low-contrast labels on light surfaces

lime-surveyor.$description: Lime Surveyor — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

marsh-olive.$description: Marsh Olive — Gradient transition shade for the lime accent — deeper stop used in horizontal lime fades

nb-international-pro.$description: Display and body — the brand's primary voice. Set at 72px for hero statements and 58px for section headers with -0.03em tracking, producing a compressed, editorial presence. Also carries body text at 18px (lh 1.62) and UI labels at 13–14px. Its humanist warmth prevents the dark canvas from feeling cold or corporate.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Interface annotations, data labels, button text, tag values, and secondary display moments. The monospaced geometry reads as coordinates, timestamps, and telemetry — reinforcing the field-instrument metaphor. Set in weight 300 for hero-scale data callouts (65px) to keep mono from feeling mechanical at large sizes.
